pulse.name: Dignity & Recognition
pulse.blurb: Who you are, respect, and equal standing in your community
pulse.a: I am treated with dignity and equal respect in my day-to-day life.
pulse.b: I can be myself in this community without having to hide who I am.
pulse.c: I could [[stand up for someone]], back them against [[being pushed around]], or [[offer support]].
pulse.d: I could use someone in my corner to back me up against [[unfair treatment]], [[being put down]], or [[discrimination]].

pulse.name: Purpose & Opportunity
pulse.blurb: Goals, learning, work, and personal development
pulse.a: I have clear avenues to learn, work, or build the future I want.
pulse.b: I am making steady progress toward my personal or work goals.
pulse.c: I could [[show someone the ropes]], [[teach a practical skill]], or [[put in a good word]].
pulse.d: I need [[practical advice]], [[training]], or [[someone to open a door]] so I can get ahead.

pulse.name: Home & Environment
pulse.blurb: Shelter, essential utilities, and safe living conditions
pulse.a: My home has reliable power, water, heating, and is safe from weather.
pulse.b: I have secure housing without fear of sudden eviction or unaffordable rent.
pulse.c: I could help out with a [[home repair]], [[yard work]], or offer a [[temporary stay]] in a pinch.
pulse.d: I need help with [[home repairs]], [[high power bills]], or [[finding secure housing]].

pulse.name: Rest & Joy
pulse.blurb: Sleep, downtime, recreation, and mental breathing room
pulse.a: I have enough genuine free time to rest and recharge away from constant demands.
pulse.b: I regularly get good sleep and time for fun, hobbies, or seeing friends.
pulse.c: I could look after [[chores or errands]], [[pets]], or [[give an exhausted friend a break]].
pulse.d: I need a [[proper break]], [[catch-up sleep]], or [[relief from exhaustion]].

pulse.name: Voice & Power
pulse.blurb: Having a say, legal standing, and autonomy over your life
pulse.a: I know my basic legal rights and have enough independence to make my own choices.
pulse.b: I have a real say in decisions affecting my life and can stand my ground with landlords, employers, or agencies.
pulse.c: I could [[lend a vehicle]], [[lend tools or gear]], or [[help with confusing paperwork]].
pulse.d: I need help dealing with [[confusing paperwork]], [[red tape]], or [[a dispute]].

pulse.name: Truth & Courage
pulse.blurb: Community trust, keeping promises, and honest dealings
pulse.a: People in this community generally keep their word, act honestly, and can be trusted.
pulse.b: I can earn my living and go about my day with a clean conscience.
pulse.c: I would [[stand by a neighbor]], [[act as a character reference]], or [[help during a dispute]].
pulse.d: I need someone with backbone to [[stand by me]], [[help with a dispute]], or [[get a fair hearing]].

pulse.name: Care & Nourishment
pulse.blurb: Food security, emotional support, and emergency help
pulse.a: I have reliable access to nutritious, affordable food where I live.
pulse.b: I have trustworthy friends or neighbors nearby I can turn to if things go wrong.
pulse.c: I could [[share food or meals]], [[give a lift]], or [[check in on someone doing it tough]].
pulse.d: I need [[groceries]], [[practical emergency help]], or [[someone to talk to]].
